title: Good Morning, Kimi!

intro.title: Meet Kimi!
intro.sub: A little girl who LOVES sleeping... maybe a little too much. 💤

scenes.title: Wake Up, Sleepyhead!
scenes.caption:
The sun is up. Mr. Rooster says cock-a-doodle-doo!
But someone is still dreaming...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Good morning. Time to wake up!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wake up, you sleepyhead. Rise and shine!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Just five more minutes... 😴

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: I'll count to three. One... two... Come on!

scenes.title: Splash, Splash!
scenes.caption: Water goes splash! Bubbles go pop!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Time to wash your face. Turn on the water.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wash your neck, too.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: All by myself! 🫧

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Watch out for the slippery floor!

scenes.title: The Sugar-Bug Battle
scenes.caption:
Tiny sugar bugs are hiding in Kimi's mouth.
Toothbrush to the rescue!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Time to brush your teeth. Brush up and down.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't forget to brush deep inside.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't forget to brush your tongue.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Gargle and spit! Ptooey! 💦

scenes.title: Breakfast Power-Up
scenes.caption: Yummy smells come from the kitchen...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's time for breakfast. Come and sit at the table.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: How is it? Isn't it good?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yummy, yummy! 🍌

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Eating breakfast makes you strong. Just take one more bite!

scenes.title: The Missing Sock Mystery
scenes.caption: One sock, two socks... wait. Where is the OTHER sock?!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's get changed. Can you get dressed by yourself?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yes, I can! ...Oops! 🙈

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your socks don't match. Where is your other sock?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's button your shirt. There you go!

scenes.title: Wrong Feet, Hee Hee!
scenes.caption: Left foot, right shoe? Right foot, left shoe? Silly Kimi!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Put on your shoes.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Your shoes are on the wrong feet. Switch shoes!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hee hee hee! 👟

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You need your sneakers if you want to run!

songs: 👕 This Is the Way We Get Dressed

ending.title: What a Morning, Kimi!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Lunchtime & Playtime! 🍱🧸
